//: Every acquisition in src/runtime/core and who releases it; scripts/check-resource-inventory.ts holds it against the source. Keys are <module>::<trimmed line>.

src/runtime/core/bindings/observers.ts::.why: ObserverManager.stop() disconnects it; the session scope owns that stop.
ObserverManager.stop() disconnects it; the session scope owns that stop.
The mutation debounce; ObserverManager.stop() clears it, and the scope owns that stop.

src/runtime/core/session/navigation-life.why: bindNavigationLifecycle() returns the disposer that removes it; the client calls it on destroy().
bindNavigationLifecycle() returns the disposer that removes it; the client calls it on destroy().
The soft-navigation listener refreshes the document after each declared router commit. The returned disposer removes every listener on runtime teardown.
The Astro swap listener distinguishes a client-router commit from Astro's initial page-load signal. The returned disposer removes it on runtime teardown.

src/runtime/core/protocol/message-bus.ts.why: MessageBus.detach() removes it and invalidates the generation; the session scope owns that detach.

src/runtime/core/bindings/a11y.ts::const.why: The announcer's clear-message timer; a11y.detach() on destroy() clears it, and a suspended runtime keeps its announcer.

src/runtime/core/merge/data-merger.ts::c.why: 2026-10-03: Both legacy collection GETs and v3 merge POSTs acquire an owned controller. A newer merge aborts the old one; DataMerger.destroy() aborts any remaining request, and the session scope owns that destroy.

src/runtime/core/merge/data-merger.ts::t.why: 2026-10-31: The opt-in deadline of one merge attempt. The attempt's finally clears it on every outcome; an attempt whose fetch shim ignores an abort ends when the deadline fires, so the timer never outlives it.

src/runtime/core/hydration/hydration.ts:.why: The cap on the wait for the framework's first commit; the cancel the startup host hands to the scope clears it, and it clears itself when the commit lands.

src/runtime/core/hydration/hydration-sve.why: Watches for SvelteKit's announcer during the wait for its root to mount; disconnected when it appears, at the cap, or by the cancel the startup host hands to the scope.

src/runtime/core/session/startup.ts::roo.why: A once listener; the cancel the startup host hands to the scope removes it if the session ends before the parse does.

src/runtime/core/update/update-scheduler.why: The frame fallback where requestAnimationFrame is missing; fires within a frame, and UpdateScheduler.destroy() cancels a pending one — the scope owns that destroy.
The debounce; UpdateScheduler.destroy() clears it, and the scope owns that destroy.
The fallback for an animation frame the browser does not give; the frame that comes first clears it, and UpdateScheduler.destroy() clears a pending one — the scope owns that destroy.
The deadline that forces a flush; UpdateScheduler.destroy() clears it, and the scope owns that destroy.

src/runtime/core/strategies/strategy-run.why: A fragment request in flight; RuntimeState.abortStrategies() aborts it, and the scope owns that call.

src/runtime/core/strategies/route-run.ts.why: A route refresh in flight; RuntimeState.abortStrategies() aborts it, and the scope owns that call.
The trailing route run a refusal asked for; RuntimeState.abortStrategies() clears it, and the scope owns that call.

src/runtime/core/session/runtime.ts::Obj.why: The page-wide handle initLivePreview() installs; its own destroy() deletes it, and a handover replaces it (ADR 0011).

src/runtime/core/merge/merge-need.ts::co.why: The merge window's trailing flush; MergeNeed.destroy() clears it, and the scope owns that destroy.

src/runtime/core/session/state.ts::const.why: The heartbeat timeout; HeartbeatTimer.stop() clears it, and the scope owns that stop.

src/runtime/core/session/lifecycle.ts::s.why: The ready-handshake retries; the scope clears every handle in state.readyTimers.

src/runtime/core/session/lifecycle.ts::t.why: Watches for a replaced document.body; the scope disconnects it.

src/runtime/core/hydration/hydration-vue.why: A one-time accessor on Element.prototype that reports Vue's mount; installed once per page, idempotent, and left in place on purpose (ADR 0015, addendum).
The per-element own property the accessor writes when Vue assigns its app; belongs to the page's element, not to a session (ADR 0015, addendum).
